description: nearest() passes the candidate's lon where distanceKm expects lat and vice versa.

bugs.hint: distanceKm(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) is called with (from.lat, from.lon, c.lon, c.lat) — the candidate's coordinates are swapped, so the wrong point is returned.

traps.why: the haversine formula itself is correct.
initialising bestDist to Infinity is correct.
